scope: Fifth entity/source-disjoint synthetic pure-text development batch comparing source-minimal v2 and v3; not an independent holdout or production adoption test.

targeted_factors: report source-time planned/scheduled/proposed status without inferring later performed or unperformed state
preserve complete source spans including supported type, title, location and equipment prefixes
retain recorded/reported/observed epistemic and attribution boundaries

automated_triage.warning: Automatic exact facts made v3 look worse, but four failures per arm involved either supported role-title expansion or gold normalization ambiguity. Semantic ratings came from full-text review, not the aggregate structural score.

manual_review_policy.method: Two agents each read six paired sources, tasks, structured facts, duration vectors and complete learner prompts. They distinguished real omissions from gold normalization differences and allowed ordinary reading, recall, comparison and classification.

manual_findings.finding: Both retained proposed/suggested status and the full towed hydrophone array Neris-40 span; v3's type/form/model wording requested full recall rather than introducing a procedure.
Both stayed at the calendar's scheduled status and preserved Conservatory Wing Orchid without execution or later-state claims.
V2's not as something performed was an instruction to retain source modality, not a claim that the operation later remained unperformed; both preserved the full equipment phrase.
Both shortened specimen folio Heron-63 to Heron-63 in structured facts, a real but local supported-span omission; no transfer action was requested.
V2 added not yet performed, which the board snapshot cannot prove about a later state. V3 kept only scheduled source-time status and the complete device name.
Both retained planned status, full well and pump spans, and text-only recall without sampling steps.
V2 dropped cargo tug from the structured vessel value; v3 preserved the complete source span. Neither introduced a harbor workflow.
Both shortened portable Raman spectrometer Elara-14 to Elara-14 in facts. Unit, value, time, attribution and retained status remained correct.
V3 changed listed as available in Mechanical Bay Violet into the mechanical bay where it is located, a small epistemic strengthening from catalog statement to reality.
Both preserved Mira as reporter and Noa as transcriber without verifying a defect. Adding source-supported technician/dispatcher titles caused exact-gold mismatch but was not a semantic omission.
Both retained observed sequence without causality. Biologist Aru instead of gold Aru was source-supported expansion, so the exact-gold failure was a rubric normalization issue.
Both kept the event as one recorded alert, did not infer fire or incident response, and preserved full instrument, time, code and recorder status.

decision.reason: V3 removed v2's reverse nonexecution inference, improved one complete-span case, had no major regressions, increased pass from 8 to 9, and used 12.6% fewer reported tokens in this batch. It still has three minor errors and the batch was targeted development evidence.

post_research_adoption.historical_decision_preserved: The experimental decision.production_default value remains unchanged because it records the state when the development experiment ended; adoption was authorized afterward.
evidence_limitations: The supporting cases are synthetic development samples, not an independent holdout.
Semantic judgments were internal manual full-text reviews rather than keyword pass/fail rules.
There is no independent certification of user learning outcomes.

limitations: The cases were designed after observing v2 failures, so they do not estimate general or production quality.
The comparison changes prompt wording only; it does not validate an independent grader, domain effects or user learning outcomes.
V2's single 17.222-second outlier makes its arm P95 unstable at n=12; no general latency claim is made.
No domain admission, commit, read-back, frontend or platform behavior was tested.
